patch:
diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py b/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py
index 1267cc2..f90f656 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py
@@ -57,6 +57,17 @@ Rules:
 - true, echo, printf, pwd, directory listings, and display-only reads are not completion checks.
 - Use replan when the current approach is wrong. Use stop only when blocked, unsafe, or impossible.
 - Keep rationale short. State the current fact and why the selected action changes or proves it.
+- Before choosing finish, re-read the ORIGINAL TASK and enumerate every literal requirement: exact
+  output paths and filenames, formats, field names, units, rounding, ordering, ports, and
+  permissions. Verify each one literally; a plausible-looking result is not proof.
+- Test the deliverable the way an independent grader would: from a fresh process, using the
+  required path (not a scratch location), with any example inputs and expected outputs given in the
+  task, and with at least one edge case or different input. Compare against expected values
+  numerically or byte-wise rather than by eye. Persistent services and files must still work
+  without any state from earlier shell sessions.
+- Do not stop as "impossible" or "blocked" until you have tried at least two different
+  approaches (alternative tools, installing from available local packages, simpler algorithms).
+  Prefer a working partial-to-full solution over giving up.
 """.strip()
 
 _REVIEW_RULES = """
